title: Meal Planning for Gout
subtitle: Evidence-based meal planning considerations related to meal planning for gout.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports dietary purine limitation, alcohol moderation, and hydration to reduce gout flare risk. Emerging evidence suggests vitamin C and low-fat dairy may aid uric acid control. Limitations include individual variability and need for comprehensive management.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
